citations.title: BNP Paribas Earnings - Q3 2025 Analysis & Highlights

sentences.text: BNP Paribas targets a return on tangible equity above 13% in 2028 and a cost/income ratio below 56%, up from 11.6% RoTE and 12.6% CET1 at end-2025.
The group guides to net income and EPS compound annual growth above 10% over 2025-2028, a trajectory management says is not yet fully reflected in consensus.

sentences.quote: Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) ratio reached 13%, up 20 basis points from the prior quarter, achieving the target previously set for end of 2027 eighteen months early.
sentences.text: The 13% CET1 target was reached at 30 June 2026, well ahead of the original end-2027 schedule, giving more room for shareholder returns, with a minimum 60% payout policy from 2027.

sentences.quote: Comprehensive review of support functions announced to amplify annual savings from EUR 700 million to EUR 1 billion through pooling and streamlining, amplifying AI use, and simplifying organization.
sentences.text: An efficiency programme lifted the annual cost savings goal to 1 billion euros from 700 million, with about 80% of savings identified.
Diversification supports growth, including the AXA Investment Managers integration and record CIB revenues in 2025.

thesis_pillars.text: The 13% CET1 target was reached at 30 June 2026, well ahead of the original end-2027 schedule, giving more room for shareholder returns, with a minimum 60% payout policy from 2027. An efficiency programme lifted the annual cost savings goal to 1 billion euros from 700 million, with about 80% of savings identified.
